text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "What kind of person is Pearl?" Youcame to me, a princess, for that?
choice_data_list: That's right. Aren't you two roommates?
That's right. Aren't you two roommates?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to ask Kawakami Princess,<n>Seeking the Pearl's roommate, about<n>Pearl's everyday behavior.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Let me think... Pearl is always loud<n>and full of energy, but every now and<n>then she becomes<n>uncharacteristically quiet. For<n>example...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The other day, a group of us were<n>trying the "Super Spicy Takoyaki<n>Roulette." Pearl yelled, "Nothing is<n>impossible for me—I won't get the<n>spicy one!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Even when there was only one left,<n>and everyone knew what it was, she<n>gobbled it down fearlessly. Let me tell<n>you, she got reeeal quiet after that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just because something isn'ttechnically impossible, that doesn'tmake it any less unlikely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I had believed that Seeking the Pearl<n>was more than just a boisterous<n>loudmouth, but maybe I was wrong...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later, I think back to the<n>scrimmage where she got labeled<n>"difficult to work with."

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Seeking the Pearl is going<n>sideways out of the gate, straight to<n>the outer edge of the track! Did she<n>hit the gate on her way out?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm on the outermost lane, and<n>currently in last place...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But! If you think I'm waving the white<n>flag here, then you've got another<n>one coming! Never surrender!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Pearl? You're entering your<n>last spurt from that position?!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl, I'm impressed you<n>made it to third after that start, but<n>why did you go sideways in the first<n>place?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The reason... I ran sideways...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Open your ears and listen carefully.<n>There, you can hear it, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I close my eyes and try to listen...

text_block_list.name: Bento Seller
text_block_list.text: Bentos, bentos! ♪ Get them hot and<n>fresh! ♪ Only 500 yen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I was charmed by that voice! Bento<n>boxes—they're one of my favorite<n>foods!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well, the race is over, so I'm going to<n>grab lunch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is she joking, or is she serious about<n>that being her reason? Either way,<n>Seeking the Pearl dashes off.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Haha... I can't get a read on her at all.<n>The fact she managed to recover<n>after such a poor start speaks<n>volumes to her talent...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: But I just don't know about her<n>personality. I've never heard of an<n>Umamusume who runs sideways<n>just because she heard someone<n>selling bento boxes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She did say that, but I feel like there's<n>more to it than just that. I mean, she<n>doesn't look like the type to be super<n>fascinated by bento boxes anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What is she hiding? Let's see... when<n>it comes to bentos...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to unravel the mystery, I find<n>myself scanning bento stalls in the<n>mall's deli on my day off. I guess<n>Seeking the Pearl's words are still on<n>my mind.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a coincidence. If it isn't the<n>trainer who wanted to turn the world<n>upside-down. Are bento boxes your<n>hobby as well?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, I don't blame you—it's not<n>easy to pass up the International<n>Bento Fair. Come, let's go eat while<n>we take a stroll by the shore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...I guess bentos really are her hobby.<n>And so, I enjoy an unexpected, but<n>not unwelcome, dinner with Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, that was magnificent. It was<n>like a jewelry box brimming with the<n>sights of the world...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even the Italian roast lamb and the<n>French croquette were customized to<n>fit in the bento box...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This meal was a tribute to limitless<n>possibility. Each food is well-defined,<n>and yet each item has its own<n>individuality. This goes both for side<n>dishes...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And for us Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pearl's final sentence shows me a<n>glimpse into her inner dialogue.<n>Perhaps I wasn't mistaken...
choice_data_list: Can I ask why you ran sideways?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pluck up my courage and ask her<n>the question that's been on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Why I ran sideways? Ah, you mean<n>that scrimmage from the other day. I<n>believe I already answered this<n>question, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I was charmed by the bento seller's<n>voice.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're a little different from the<n>rest. But, you know...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I don't hate that. Right, I'll spill the<n>beans.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll tell you the truth. Think of it as a<n>dessert to our meal, okay? ♪
